title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – Sonpeth Nagari Sahakari Bank Maryadit, Sonpeth, Dist. Parbhani, Maharashtra – Extension of Period
description: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to Sonpeth Nagari Sahakari Bank Maryadit, Sonpeth, Dist. Parbhani, Maharashtra vide Directive No. NGP.DOS.SSM 3.No.S403/15-04-395/2025-2026 dated July 29, 2025 for a period of six months up to close of business on January 30, 2026, which was last extended up to the close of business on July 30, 2026 vide Directive No. DOR.MON/D-09/12.22.718/2026-27 dated April 22, 2026.
